verdicts.reason: The quote only names the port as the rv_timer interrupt output. It is a description of the connection, with nothing to verify and nothing checkable every cycle from interface signals.

The quote states the output is an event-type interrupt with INTR_ENABLE0, INTR_STATE0 and INTR_TEST0 registers. That can be exercised in a scenario by setting events and using the enable and test registers. Strength is MUST, actor is system, and check is scenario.

questions.question: The event-type interrupt behaviour is defined only by reference to the comportability specification. Which exact semantics should be verified: INTR_STATE set on the event, output equal to STATE AND ENABLE, INTR_TEST setting STATE, and write-1-to-clear?
